pass_criterion: asset_id, version, source hash, owner, license and intended use are recorded
one applicable SimReady profile name and exact version are declared; target runtime is named
visualization, perception, navigation, grasping, manipulation or control consumers and their acceptance metrics are named
simready-validate runs in a pinned environment against the declared profile and asset
zero failed requirements in the selected profile; any failed requirement fails its feature and profile
all MUST requirements pass with no waiver
every unmet SHOULD has an owner, written justification, impact analysis and expiry or remediation date
profile, profile_version, validation date and passed feature history are written to SimReady_Metadata
validator JSON, tool/spec/profile versions, command, asset hash and logs are immutable and linked to the release
default prim, references, payloads, variants, textures and other dependencies resolve in a clean environment
metersPerUnit, kilogramsPerUnit where applicable, timeCodesPerSecond and upAxis are explicit and match the acceptance contract
source files, capture or CAD versions, conversion recipe, authoring tools and redistribution rights are traceable
runtime-specific overrides are isolated from the canonical neutral asset and can be regenerated
required geometry, normals, UVs, LOD or proxy variants and material bindings pass the selected profile and project lint
evidence: validator JSON and geometry QA report

pass_criterion: texture paths, color spaces and size limits pass the profile; no missing or unintended fallback material
key dimensions and point-to-surface error meet task-specific thresholds frozen before production
every required rigid shape has valid collision representation required by the selected profile
mass, center of mass and inertia are present or validly derived; values are finite, positive where required and physically plausible
collision envelope preserves task-critical gaps, handles, contact faces and support surfaces while meeting contact-count and performance budgets
friction, restitution, damping and other active material parameters are measured, bounded or explicitly randomized with provenance
rest stability, drop, incline, push or grasp-slip tests match frozen tolerances without persistent penetration, explosion or unbounded jitter
one intended articulation structure is present; body and joint graph has no unintended cycles or disconnected simulated parts
joint type, parent-child frames, axes, limits and initial positions match CAD, URDF or measured ground truth
driven joints have intended drive mode, target, stiffness, damping, effort and velocity limits for the target runtime
evidence: validator JSON and drive sweep test

pass_criterion: full permitted joint sweep completes without unintended collision, discontinuity, instability or geometry detachment
semantic-label features are included in the selected or custom profile; labels are not assumed merely because a base prop or robot profile passes
class, instance, part, affordance, receptacle and state labels required by consumers are complete, unique and schema-valid
active RGB, depth, LiDAR, radar or other response parameters are present and calibrated or randomized within documented bounds
asset loads in every declared target runtime from a clean cache with no missing dependencies or fatal errors
all runtime warnings are either fixed or linked to an approved deviation; no unknown warnings remain
load time, RAM or VRAM, render throughput, physics step rate and contact counts meet the frozen deployment budget
repeated runs under fixed seed and environment remain within defined state and metric tolerances
canonical asset remains unchanged and each runtime adapter passes its own load, physics and task regression
evidence: adapter build hashes and test matrix

pass_criterion: synthetic or simulated data meets the predeclared KPI on held-out real data versus the agreed baseline
collision, traversability and sensor scene support the declared planner or policy success, safety and performance thresholds
grasp, open, place, insert or other target task meets declared success, slip, contact and intervention thresholds in simulation and the required real holdout
asset-induced failures are separated from controller, policy, sensor and simulator failures; unresolved critical asset failures are zero
profile validation, package lint, runtime smoke tests and applicable task tests pass on the exact release hash
manifest, canonical asset, adapters, validator JSON, stamps, measurements, deviations, test reports and hashes are linked
asset owner, simulation or runtime owner and task consumer approve the exact version; safety or data owner signs when applicable
